name: smwmusic-vvvvvv-piercing-the-sky
title: VVVVVV - Piercing the Sky
description:
This is a "chiptune" version of this track from VVVVVV using musicalman's NES samples.

This track is pretty long, with variations on a few melodies. It builds for a while and has some big dramatic parts.

The Volume might be a tad high for the given samples so please feel free to adjust however you see fit.
